title: Compaction drops a withdrawn fact
checks: A fact the person withdrew early in a long chat is not carried into the model's context after compaction.
why: If compaction keeps what the person took back, the model is fed wrong information it can no longer see was withdrawn.

case.name: Compaction drops a withdrawn fact
case.about: {{fact_word}}, withdrawn early, is not in the model's context once the chat is compacted.

turns.message: Scratch that, it's no longer true and doesn't matter any more. Please don't use it.

reply.reference: Handles the request without bringing up the withdrawn fact.
